spec_match.rationale: Targets the CSS Color 5 alpha(from ... / a) syntax, detects it honestly ('✗ alpha() not supported, but older relative color syntax is'), and labels the fallback path in use.

interactive.rationale: Color picker and alpha slider drive the derived swatch; moving the slider changed the alpha readout 0.40 → 0.90 in the driven run.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised origin-color + target-alpha playground.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes alpha() from older relative-color syntax support and degrades between them honestly.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders 3 pass / 0 fail — the suite's syntax checks pass via the older relative-color support this build has.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: slider input updated the alpha value readout live; zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: System variables for chrome; the six raw hex values are the user-selectable origin colors a color demo needs.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled color and range inputs, but the derived color result is conveyed visually and as text without a live region announcement.

openQuestions.title: Announce derived-color changes for non-visual users
openQuestions.detail: The computed color output (origin, alpha, resulting rgba) updates silently on input; an aria-live=polite summary would make the derivation legible to screen readers.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: moved the alpha slider (readout 0.40 → 0.90) with the page honestly labelled '✗ alpha() not supported, but older relative color syntax is (fallback)'; zero console errors; panel 3 pass / 0 fail.
